messages:
Mara (Support): FYI — customer Samir is hitting a steady stream of 429s + elevated p95 on generation. Tenant ID: tenant-88fc. They say it started ~10:14 UTC, sample request-id 01FZ9Z8K2X.
Samir (Customer): yes, getting 429s intermittently and long tails on responses (3-10s). Happens on /v1/chat only. Not seeing obvious retries on our side.
Mara (Support): reassigning to SRE for telemetry. @Devin can you take a look at route-level quotas and any recent rule changes? :eyes:
oncall-bot: New support ticket #SUP-4122 assigned to Devin.
Devin (Eng SRE): looking. Can you paste a few request headers/IDs and time window? I want to map to our rate-limit logs.
Mara (Support): pasted above; also sample curl we asked them to run: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"redwood-1-8k","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat```
Samir (Customer): here's a small batch of request-ids: 01FZ9Z8K2X, 01FZ9ZK5Q, 01FZ9ZLG7T (10:14:12 - 10:16:00 UTC). We have modest qps, not a spike from our side.
Devin (Eng SRE): pulling logs... grep on tenant-88fc shows repeated 429s at the edge: ```edge.rate_limit.block tenant=tenant-88fc route=/v1/chat rule=per-route-burst limit=120 window_s=60```. But interestingly there's a burst window with many short-lived parallel connections.
Sofia (ML Infra): ping — model redwood-1-8k was autoscaling yesterday; there was a transient config change that tightened concurrency per-VM to 8 for safety. That can increase observed 429s if many clients open parallel streams.
Devin (Eng SRE): okay, two hypotheses: (A) genuine tenant burst beyond their allocated burst tokens, or (B) our concurrency cap reduced effective throughput causing backpressure and token exhaustion. Need to attribute.
Mara (Support): customer insists they didn't change traffic. Any obs we can show them to prove it's infra-side?
Devin (Eng SRE): yes — I'll produce a short snapshot from the limits dashboard: per-tenant token burn, per-route 429 rate, and instance concurrency over time. If instance concurrency dips while incoming QPS is steady, that's infra.
Sofia (ML Infra): also check KV cache hit rate for chats — if cache misses spike, per-token compute increases and throughput drops. Run: ```SELECT time, kv_cache_hit_pct, instance_concurrency FROM infra.metrics WHERE tenant='tenant-88fc' AND time > '2025-03-18T10:00:00Z'```
Devin (Eng SRE): ran quick query — result: kv_cache_hit_pct dropped from 84% -> 21% around 10:13 UTC, simultaneous instance concurrency fell as autoscalers cycled 3 VMs for that model. I'll attach graphs to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
Mara (Support): perfect. Can we also produce a per-route attribution snapshot so we can say "429s mostly on /v1/chat using model redwood-1-8k"?
Devin (Eng SRE): yes — generating A/B breakdown. For the period 10:12-10:20: 92% of 429s from /v1/chat, 88% of those requests used redwood-1-8k, and 77% came from 3 specific source IPs (likely client-side parallelism).
Samir (Customer): hmm we do have a worker farm that parallelizes requests, but not to that extent. Could be some retry loop kicking in. We'll audit.
Mara (Support): action items: 1) Attach dashboard slices (per-tenant burn, per-route 429s, instance concurrency, kv cache hit). 2) Recommend temporary soft limits or longer retry-backoff for the tenant. 3) SRE/Infra to review autoscaler config for redwood-1-8k.
Devin (Eng SRE): noted. For immediate mitigation I can bump their burst window by +30% for 30m as an emergency measure while we triage. Will log the change.
Sofia (ML Infra): I'll also revert the temporary concurrency cap for that model to previous safe value and watch P95.
Mara (Support): Samir — we'll apply the bump now and follow up with the dashboard snapshots and a root-cause summary. Thanks for the quick details. :thumbsup:
Samir (Customer): thanks — appreciate it.
Devin (Eng SRE): mitigation applied at 10:28 UTC (audit-id AUD-8932). Observability note: saved query links: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/limits/per-tenant?tenant=tenant-88fc and https://dash.redwood.internal/d/limits/per-route?route=/v1/chat
Mara (Support): closing the thread for now, will reopen if 429s recur after the next 30m.
Devin (Eng SRE): leaving here — follow-up tasks created: TSK-2145 (autoscaler review), TSK-2146 (retry/backoff guidance doc).
oncall-bot: Reminder: pinging SLO incident channel if recurrence > 5% 429s for 30m.
